Sample of Full Time Employment Contract For UAE Nationals

This Agreement (the “Agreement”) is entered into on [Date], between [Company Name], a [Type of Company] with its principal office located at [Company Address] (hereinafter referred to as the “Company”), and [Employee Name], a UAE national residing at [Employee Address] (hereinafter referred to as the “Employee”).

The Company is willing to hire the Employee for the [Job Title] position.]. The Employee affirms to effectively perform the responsibilities imposed by the Company. This will be outlined in the attached job description.

Considering the services provided, the Company will balance the Employee with a monthly salary of [Amount] in UAE Dirhams. It is payable on the [specific day] of each month. The Employee will also be eligible to [mention any additional benefits, allowances, or bonuses].

The standard working hours will be [Number] hours per week. This is followed with a break for [Number] minutes every [specify frequency]. The Employee affirms to work additional hours whenever necessary for the proper fulfilling of duties.

The Employee is entitled to [Number] days of annual leave per year, to be scheduled after mutual agreement with the Company. Any unused leave days may be carried forward to the following year.

This Agreement might be terminated by either party with [Number] days’ written notice or compensation in lieu of notice. The Company has all the right to fire the Employee’s services without notice.

During and after the employment period, the Employee is required to maintain the confidentiality. This is applicable on proprietary or confidential information belonging to the Company.

The laws of the United Arab Emirates shall supervise and understand this Agreement. Any disagreement that may arise related to it, it shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction.

Things To Must Check in UAE Employment Contract Letter

When examining a employment contract UAE pdf letter, it is crucial to conduct a thorough assessment. By doing this, you can ensure legal compliance and mutual understanding.

Review the job title carefully and associated responsibilities outlined in the employment contract. It further ensures that they reflect the agreed-upon terms. Confirm the compensation and benefits. This should include salary, allowances, bonuses, and any additional perks, confirming alignment with the negotiated terms.

The working hours and overtime period must be in compliance with the legal regulations within the country. Apart from this, scrutinize details related to leave entitlements, such as annual leave and public holidays. This will help you confirm adherence to statutory requirements.

Pay close attention to termination clauses, specifying conditions, notice periods, and associated compensation. If applicable, assess the terms of any probationary period. The duration and conditions for extension and termination must be included.

Verify the clarity of confidentiality and non-compete clauses, safeguarding intellectual property and outlining any post-employment restrictions. Confirm that the employment contract specifies the governing law, typically stating UAE laws.

Additionally, check the dispute resolution procedures, whether through arbitration or legal channels, to ensure a clear path for conflict resolution. Confirm that you have attached all referenced policies, appendices, or additional documents, and finally, assess whether the contract complies with UAE labor laws, securing the rights of both parties involved. Utilizing an employment contract UAE sample can assist in ensuring a comprehensive and legally sound agreement.
